maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the uppermost isolated row are positioned approximately 1.5 spot-widths superior to the secondary dense row, maintaining a near-parallel horizontal alignment with the dorsal margin of the rhinarium.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 82% melanin saturation; dark pixels occupy the lateral and inferior boundaries, with a distinct pink/pale depigmented region concentrated on the superior-central apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized dark pigmented spot or possible scar is visible on the upper-central pink region of the rhinarium, slightly right of the midline.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of dark, high-contrast spots is visible on the lower lip and chin area, following a different spatial frequency than the vibrissae spots.
